purpose: Priority-15 through priority-10 curation: exact domestic courts/police/armed-forces/counter-institutions while preserving generic Police and process labels as non-identities.
identityRule: Promote jurisdiction-specific stable institutions only. Generic `Police`, UPR, FPIC and ECL terminology do not become first-class actors/projects.
explicitDeferrals: Generic `Police` references in FJI/MNE/MWI/SUR/ALB/JAM/LCA do not identify one exact legal body/unit at the dossier granularity and remain deferred.
explicitNonGoals: Do not infer project involvement from police/armed-forces identity.
Do not materialize UPR or FPIC as Actors.
Do not treat `ECL Restricted Project` as a discovered Project instance.
